steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each affected group is matched to an impact rating and each support need to an owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Change with no affected group
findings.fix: Name the groups the change affects

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] group-finance.md:12  Group with no impact rating.
       Fix: Rate the group's impact.
[medium] change-desc.md:19  Change with no affected group.
       Fix: Name the groups the change affects.
[low] support-needs.csv:26  Support need with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: The people's own view.
pros: Checks a group with no impact rating, a change with no affected group, and a support need with no owner.
cons: Not checked: The people's own view.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-change-impact-assessment skill on the records for this review.
